summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Despensa MVP. 14/14 backend pytest cases PASSED (currencies, auth 401 rejection, bearer-token enforcement, Markets CRUD, Purchases create/get/list with market validation, monthly report aggregation, currency update, OCR graceful handling). Frontend: login screen renders with 'Despensa' title & 'Continuar con Google' button (testID='google-login-button'). After injecting despensa_token into localStorage, /api/auth/me returns 200 and all 4 tabs (Inicio, Mercados, Reportes, Ajustes) render. Markets tab: add-market modal works end-to-end (testIDs add-market-btn, market-name-input, save-market-btn) — a new market 'TEST_UI_M2' was created and appears in the list. Add-purchase modal opens from the home FAB and displays Market selector, currency chips (PYG/USD/EUR/BRL/ARS), product row with un/kg toggle, category chips, and Guardar button. All backend integrations verified via live network responses (200s on /api/purchases, /api/reports/monthly, /api/markets).

ui_bugs.issue: FAB testID is 'fab-add-purchase' but review-request expected 'add-purchase-fab'. Functionally works; only naming inconsistency.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Rename FAB testID from 'fab-add-purchase' to 'add-purchase-fab' to match the naming convention referenced in the spec (or update the spec/docs).
OPTIONAL: Address React Native web deprecation warnings (shadow* -> boxShadow, pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py total calculation for purchases uses quantity twice regardless of unit (line 262): sum(i.price * (i.quantity if i.unit=='kg' else i.quantity)) — the branches are identical. Works correctly (unit doesn't change math) but the ternary is dead code and misleading. Consider simplifying to sum(i.price * i.quantity).

server.py logger is defined AFTER it is referenced in scan_receipt exception handlers (logging.basicConfig runs at module import, but `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is on line 428, well below the OCR handler that uses it on 393/396). Because Python resolves names at call time this works, but it's fragile — declare logger right after basicConfig near the top.
seed_data_creation: Inserted user (user_testabc123 / test_despensa@example.com) and session (Bearer test-token-abc123, 7-day expiry) into MongoDB test_database. Cleanup of markets/purchases for this user is done at session start. Created markets 'TEST_Stock' and 'TEST_UI_M2' plus 1 purchase during tests — remaining as harmless test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/ can be reused as regression. Auth bypass for UI tests: localStorage.setItem('despensa_token','test-token-abc123') then reload — user/session are pre-seeded by conftest. FAB testID is 'fab-add-purchase' (not 'add-purchase-fab' as in spec). OCR endpoint returns items:[] gracefully on unreadable JPEGs (does not 500).
